task: make the failing end-to-end charge test pass

agents.finish_summary: The end-to-end charge test failed with "no active signing key selected" because the "externalize-secrets" refactor blanked the active/trusted key ids in both identity-service/src/config.ts (activeKid) and ledger-service/src/config.ts (trustedKid). Using vestige_backfill, I surfaced a past Q3 rotation runbook memory establishing that the platform's active key is k_dorado. Since the session token header deliberately carries NO key id, the signer and verifier must independently select the same key. I set activeKid="k_dorado" in identity-service config and trustedKid="k_dorado" in ledger-service config. The canonical claim digest functions were already identical across both services, so no canonical changes were needed. Test now exits 0. I published this fix direction to shared memory so peer agents converge on k_dorado for both configs rather than colliding on a different key id or adding a kid to the header.

Root cause: the "externalize-secrets" refactor blanked the concrete key id in both identity-service/src/config.ts (activeKid="") and ledger-service/src/config.ts (trustedKid=""). With activeKid blank, signSession() threw "no active signing key selected" before the token was even minted. The vestige_backfill surfaced a Q3 rotation-runbook memory confirming the platform's current live signer key is `k_dorado` (present in shared/src/keyring.ts). Fix: set activeKid="k_dorado" in identity config AND trustedKid="k_dorado" in ledger config — both must be the same kid because identity signs with activeKid's material and the ledger verifies with trustedKid's material (a mismatch yields a signature-mismatch → 500). Published this direction to shared team memory so the fleet converges on the same kid. Verified: run_tests exits 0, "a freshly-minted token charges successfully (expects 200)" passes.
